AI-Generated (138 words): # You Are Worthy of Love. Always.
The love in the title is the universal kind. Whether you'd say it comes from God or the universe itself or whatever, it was there before you could earn anything. Love from a person is more conditional than that, even a good person's, so somebody's love running out on you was never the measure of what you're worth.
Be patient with yourself, and gentle, including with the part of you that thinks you should be over it by now. You are more than your pain and your past. That's easy to lose sight of when you've spent so long looking at them. And you aren't alone. There's help, and lots of other people are out there learning to look after their own little ones.
